description: Source code for managing admission options and configuration in Kubernetes API server, including plugin registration, enabling/disabling plugins, and applying admission control to the server.

classes.name: AdmissionOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration for admission plugins, including plugin order, enable/disable lists, and plugin registration.

methods.name: NewAdmissionOptions
methods.description: Creates a new AdmissionOptions instance with default plugin order and registration.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags for admission plugin configuration.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Configures the server with the admission control chain based on the options.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the admission plugin configuration flags.

methods.name: enabledPluginNames
methods.description: Returns the ordered list of enabled plugin names based on current configuration.

methods.name: defaultEnabledPluginNames
methods.description: Returns the list of plugin names enabled by default.
